_comment: Shared behaviour contract, read by both compilers when they generate. For each TEI Processing-Model behaviour: `tag`, the HTML element that wraps the content (for the behaviours that do no more than that), and `flow`, whether it renders as a block or inline, which decides where indentation is dropped and where a line break is already implied. Behaviours without a tag render in their own way (heading, note, alternate, …). Edit here, not in either compiler. Human-readable view: docs/behaviour-table.md.
